steps.title: Look for a new substance
steps.intro: A chemical reaction rearranges atoms and bonds to make new substances. Milk souring, iron rusting, fermentation, cooking, digestion and respiration are source examples.
steps.simple: Bubbles, colour, a solid forming or temperature change can be clues.
example: Bubbles, colour, a solid forming or temperature change can be clues.
Boiling water makes bubbles but remains H2O; one visible clue alone is not proof of a chemical reaction.
